instruction: Approve all pending venmo payment requests I have received in this month, and withdraw the remaining venmo balance, if any, to my card ending in 4184.
notes: Single-app (venmo) task. Pending received requests are discovered by show_received_payment_requests(status=pending) (nullary knowledge fact received-requests-listed); the agent filters by created_at in May 2023 (current date 2023-05-18). Two this-month pending requests are modeled (reference plan has 9 calls: 2 approvals) plus one older pending request (pr-apr-pending) that must stay unapproved (negative goal). Approvals are paid from the venmo balance (no payment_card_id) so only the user's venmo_balance changes; approving invalidates the known balance (deletes balance-known), forcing show_venmo_balance after the last approval, and approvals are forbidden once the balance has been withdrawn (balance is 0). Withdraw requires the balance to be known, the cards listed, and binds the amount to the post-approval balance; the goal names card-ending-4184 as the destination. The per-object goal literals (specific requests/card) cannot be referenced in the domain-level complete-task precondition, so complete-task requires the nullary balance-withdrawn fact; last-position ordering is still enforced by (not (task-completed)) on every other action. Assumes the remaining balance after approvals is positive (otherwise the withdrawal step is skipped at runtime).
